root_causes.description: The shipping service exhibits a severe server-side latency anomaly (server-span p99 mean ~5700ms, peaking at ~9650ms vs a ~2ms baseline) while its error rate, CPU usage and pod restarts all remain normal. Its only downstream dependency (quote) stays healthy at ~1.98ms, isolating the injected/abnormal delay to shipping itself, which then propagates upstream to frontend and checkout.

evidence.expected_baseline: quote p99 ~2ms — downstream dependency healthy, excluding dependency_failure
frontend p99 ~tens of ms (healthy) — upstream propagation of shipping latency
error_rate < 0.01 — no error spike, excludes http_abort

evidence.query_or_id: get_pod_events pod_name_prefix=shipping (Successfully update ObservedGeneration and FailedMessage of resource)
evidence.observed_value: no OOMKilled/BackOff/CrashLoop/restart events for shipping pods

root_causes.description: Frontend server-span p99 is elevated (~8.1s max) as a consequence of calling the degraded shipping service; it is a propagated symptom rather than the origin, since shipping shows the largest absolute p99 deviation and frontend depends on shipping in the checkout path.

Checkout depends on shipping (topology: checkout → shipping, quote) and would inherit elevated latency, but the primary origin remains the shipping service itself which shows the largest p99 deviation while its own downstream quote stays at ~1.98ms.

evidence.observed_value: shipping p99 mean=5700ms max=9650ms (origin) while quote p99=1.980ms (healthy)

remediation_steps: Inspect flagd configuration and the shipping Deployment for an active latency fault-injection / delay flag and disable or roll back it.
Restart the shipping Deployment/pods to clear any injected in-process delay, then verify shipping server-span p99 returns to ~2ms.
Validate recovery by confirming frontend/checkout server-span p99 returns to healthy baselines and that shipping error rate and pod restarts remain at zero.
